verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a plausible capability for a government online-services platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only web-based Online Services, Web File, Quick Pay and online calculators, plus third-party 'approved software' for filing. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or markdown docs, and nothing anywhere describes an official command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
